text:
erin: Heads-up — cloud negotiations next Tues with ProviderX. Main ask: guaranteed 600 A100 GPUs across us-west2 + us-east1 for 12mo commitment. Need input on allocation, credits if unavailable, and termination carveouts.
alex: do we have recent usage curves by region? last quarter we hit ~420 peak in us-west during batch jobs, us-east avg ~120.
maria: infra note — our cluster health tests show intermittent packet loss in us-east1 during large checkpoints. If provider can't guarantee network egress for failover, SLA needs stronger credits.
kevin: from prior EDPs providers prefer to offer $$ credits not hard capacity. We should ask for a hybrid: reserved pool (hard) + burst pool (soft) with defined pricing and preemption rules. Also propose a ramp schedule (months 1-3: 200, 4-6: 400, 7-12: 600).
erin: hybrid makes sense. want explicit credit math for outages though — finance will want a formula we can run in a billing postmortem.
sam (legal): draft clause suggestion:
```
If Provider fails to deliver >= 90% of committed GPUs in the primary region for a continuous period > 48 hours, Provider will: (a) credit Customer at 2x the hourly committed rate for each affected GPU until remediation; (b) offer equivalent capacity in an alternate region within 24 hours; (c) waive cross-region egress for failover for duration of outage.
```
kevin: nice. add an escalation path + 24/7 support response SLA tied to credits. Also push for regional affinity: 70% of committed capacity must reside in primary region, remainder flexible.
alex: ops asks: pin at least 100 GPUs per AZ to avoid patch windows taking whole region offline. Add AZ-level minimums in SLA.
maria: also ask for telemetry: hourly availability feed (CSV/JSON) + API for remaining capacity view. 72h maintenance notice isn't enough — request 7d notice for planned major maintenance that affects capacity >10%.
erin: finance input — we can accept some credits but need a hard right to convert remaining committed dollars to a reserved credit for other providers if capacity shortfall persists >30 days. basically a partial termination right.
kevin: I'll draft counterproposal with: (1) hybrid reserved+burst model + ramp, (2) legal clause from @sam, (3) AZ pinning + regional affinity, (4) telemetry API + 7d notice, (5) termination/convert-to-credit if sustained shortage >30d, (6) capped weekend transient pool (we can try for 30% at committed price). Will try to keep MFN protections minimal.
sam (legal): add: avoid open-ended MFN and ensure price floor. Also watch auto-renewal triggers; want explicit renewal windows and 90d notice for contract changes.
kevin: noted. I'll also ask for a monthly report line-itemizing: committed GPUs, utilized GPUs, burst usage, credits applied.
gcp-bizdev-bot: ProviderX EDP template: https://providerx.example.com/edp-template — they typically accept ramp + credits but push back on termination language.
maria: one more ops ask — require 1.5x IO bandwidth for pinned GPUs during patch windows, otherwise we see long tail latencies. Put it in the perf appendix.
erin: great work. Action items: kevin draft by EOD Fri, alex to attach regional utilization curves, maria to export checkpoint/net perf logs, sam to prep legal redlines. We'll review Monday before send. :thumbsup:
kevin: on it. ping me if anyone finds a non-negotiable item to escalate. :eyes:
